summary: Aligned src/lib/security/env.ts with canonical Stripe billing plan environment variables after the Zod v4 typecheck fix exposed this nearby legacy drift.
changes: Replaced required STRIPE_STARTER_PRICE_ID and STRIPE_GROWTH_PRICE_ID schema fields with STRIPE_PRICE_ESSENTIAL_MONTHLY and STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL_MONTHLY.
Added STRIPE_PRICE_BUSINESS_MONTHLY as a required schema field to match the public billing catalog and .env.example.
Kept legacy fallbacks from STRIPE_STARTER_PRICE_ID to STRIPE_PRICE_ESSENTIAL_MONTHLY and STRIPE_GROWTH_PRICE_ID to STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL_MONTHLY.
Made STRIPE_PRICE_ENTERPRISE_MONTHLY optional with fallback from STRIPE_ENTERPRISE_PRICE_ID, because Enterprise is not part of the self-serve checkout flow.

build_context.last_vercel_error: ZodError.errors typecheck failure in src/lib/security/env.ts; corrected separately to ZodError.issues.
build_context.follow_up_risk_reduced: Legacy Stripe env names in env.ts no longer drift from billing/plans.ts and .env.example.

validation.expected_next_step: rerun Vercel or GitHub Security CI after commit is picked up
